era: 2019 craigslist, the same for every visitor (no crawler variant): three-column home directory in Arial/Helvetica with the serif 'craigslist' title and a left calendar/help sidebar, search pages with a grey breadcrumb bar of selects, a left filter rail and list/thumb/gallery/map views whose titles are in Times, posting pages with a serif title and body, image carousel, map and attribute boxes on the right.

sources.shows: home: 'craigslist' serif title, create a posting (yellow), my account, search craigslist field, event calendar, help/faq/abuse/legal, avoid scams & fraud, personal safety tips, terms of use, privacy policy, system status, about craigslist, best-of-craigslist, craigslist is hiring; SF bay area with sfc/sby/eby/pen/nby/scz; community/services/discussion forums/housing/for sale/jobs/gigs columns; english select, nearby cl, us cities, us states, canada, cl worldwide

for-sale search in a second city with the same bar, rail and results
